guarantees: All source pointers and raw source-component matches are validated before metadata queries. Completed results retain sources and the destination batch, including held targets and parent.

Fresh held source and target metadata are checked against qualified retained identity/kind observations. Same/Different remain reported native identity comparisons, not content equality or mutation permission.

Missing is NotApplicable, never Different; mapping/lookup/query failures remain explicit. Unqualified scopes/schemes/zero IDs/generation coverage and changed identity/kind do not become safe negative comparisons.
Only metadata queries run; no new lookup, path reopen, final-link traversal, content read, mutation, shell or elevation is introduced.

At most 256 validation/query/comparison steps per advance plus cooperative clock slices. Completed replies survive cancellation/time yields without repetition. Exceptions poison before rethrow; abandonment releases private state while issued results retain owners.
limitations: Native identity is adapter-scoped and transient. Different does not prove universal alias exclusion, namespace membership, descendant safety, collision freedom, copy feasibility or safe replacement.
Retained handles can describe old objects after either original name is replaced. Execution must separately revalidate current source/destination names, parents and capabilities.
The result is a sequence of live metadata observations, not a simultaneous content or membership snapshot. Native calls can block past cooperative slices.
This is evidence for later self-target refusal, not an enabled mutation/refusal engine or operation plan. All native-owner retirement remains worker-owned.
WP-01 remains open for descendant checks, operation-specific capabilities, native name equivalence, remaining inventories, large-view indexes and UI/worker integration. WP-02 not started.
